rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive coverage of South Korea's PIPA through 37 tools integrating the Law Research Institute API, PIPC official indexes, and a RAG corpus of 2,202 chunks including guidebooks and counsel case studies. Supports temporal validity checking, 4-layer citation verification, and recognition of 17 legal abbreviation types. Hosted on Hugging Face Spaces with an npm package for local stdio use; requires a free Law Korea Open API key.
